question: What share of the chloroplast genome do the two inverted repeats make up together?
rendered: The two inverted repeats (IRs) in the chloroplast genome of Agave angustifolia make up 26,575 bp each. Therefore, together, they make up 26,575 bp + 26,575 bp = 53,150 bp. The chloroplast genome is 157,274 bp. The IRs make up 53,150 / 157,274 ≈ 33.8% of the chloroplast genome.
